d:
BJP has fielded popular folk singer Maithili Thakur from the Alinagar Assembly seat, while RJD has nominated Vinod Mishra against her.
During our ground reporting in one of Alinagar’s villages, we met a young voter who strongly criticised both BJP and RJD — raising questions on unemployment, caste politics, candidate selection and development promises.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
